description: Test suite for PropertyField store functions in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and search of property fields with various filters and conditions.

methods.name: testCreatePropertyField
methods.description: Tests creation of property fields, including validation, ID generation, and option ID handling for multiselect fields.

methods.name: testGetPropertyField
methods.description: Tests retrieval of property fields by ID, including non-existent and group-specific retrieval.

methods.name: testGetManyPropertyFields
methods.description: Tests batch retrieval of property fields by IDs, including error handling for mismatched or outside group IDs.

methods.name: testGetFieldByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of property fields by name, including handling of multiple fields with same name, deletion, and matching criteria.

methods.name: testUpdatePropertyField
methods.description: Tests updating property fields, including validation, batch updates, ID preservation, and handling of invalid or non-existent fields.

methods.name: testDeletePropertyField
methods.description: Tests deletion of property fields, including non-existent fields, soft deletion, and group-specific deletion.

methods.name: testCountForGroup
methods.description: Tests counting property fields within a group, including handling of deleted fields and includeDeleted flag.

methods.name: testSearchPropertyFields
methods.description: Tests searching property fields with various filters: groupID, targetType, targetID, pagination, timestamps, and deletion status.

methods.name: testSearchPropertyFieldsSince
methods.description: Tests filtering property fields based on update timestamps, including boundary conditions and multiple filters.
